demon_lord.notes: Three centuries on the throne, tired and never joking: a calm, low, mature voice that plays every absurd line straight. Inner monologue is softer than speech. Narration stays silent.

serin.notes: 110 years as his secretary, never flustered: calm, elegant and businesslike.

aldric.notes: Late-30s paladin, extremely polite and capable; asks about severance pay as earnestly as tactics. Warm, clear and upright.

toby.notes: Nine and a half, earnest and blunt. The library has almost no child voices; this boy-to-young-man voice was the closest.

mysterious_applicant.notes: Serin in a blonde wig, so the same voice as Serin with a brighter put-on tone: the listener should hear it is her.
